metadata.title: 文件输入 FileUpload
metadata.description: 选择或拖入本地文件，保留已接受集合与真实拒绝原因。
metadata.descriptionEn: Choose or drop local files, retaining accepted files and real rejection reasons.
metadata.decisions: 组件只管理本地文件选择。上传状态、进度分母、失败、结果未知与恢复由应用提供；它不发请求、不制造进度、不从 Promise 推断结果。
metadata.decisionsEn: The component manages local selection only. The application supplies upload states, progress denominators, failure, unknown results, and recovery. It sends no requests, invents no progress, and infers no result from a Promise.

api.name: FileUpload
api.description: 原生 file Input、拖放、已接受列表与真实规则验证的组合。
api.descriptionEn: A native file input composed with dropping, accepted files, and real rule validation.

props.name: value / defaultValue / onValueChange
props.type: readonly File[] / readonly File[] / (files, details) => void
props.description: 受控或非受控接受集合，保留 File 引用。details 含 select/drop/remove、added/removed/event/cancel()；受控拒绝或取消不改变提交集合。
props.descriptionEn: Controlled or uncontrolled accepted files, retaining File references. details includes select/drop/remove, added, removed, event, and cancel(). Refusal or cancellation preserves submitted files.

props.name: accept / maxSize / maxFiles
props.description: 扩展名/MIME规则、每文件字节数、集合数量。大小与数量为非负安全整数，省略不限制；按 type/size/count 的实际首个失败理由拒绝，已知外部集合不静默纠正。
props.descriptionEn: Extension/MIME rules, bytes per file, and collection count. Size and count are nonnegative safe integers; omitted means unlimited. Reject with the first actual type/size/count failure; external sets are not silently repaired.

props.name: multiple
props.description: 默认是集合选择；false 的集合容量最多1，已有文件须先移除才能加入另一个，不隐式替换。
props.descriptionEn: Defaults to collection selection. false limits capacity to one; remove an existing file before adding another, with no implicit replacement.

props.name: onReject
props.description: 真实 type/size/count 拒绝；拒绝项可关闭提示，但不冒充已接受文件。
props.descriptionEn: Actual type/size/count rejections. Dismissing feedback does not make rejected files accepted.

props.name: name / form
props.description: chooser 不带最终 name；Field 可提供名称，公开 formdata 事件 append 已接受 File，不覆盖同名其它字段。显式 form 支持外部表单。
props.descriptionEn: The chooser has no final name. Field may supply it; the public formdata event appends accepted Files without replacing other same-name fields. form supports external forms.

props.name: disabled / readOnly
props.description: 阻止选择、拖放和移除；Field/原生 fieldset 禁用同样约束。只读文件继续提交，禁用排除。原生 reset 未取消时非受控恢复初始 defaultValue，受控值保留。
props.descriptionEn: Block selecting, dropping, and removing, including Field/native fieldset disabled. Read-only submits; disabled is excluded. Uncanceled native reset restores initial uncontrolled defaultValue and retains controlled values.

props.name: getStatus
props.description: 调用方真实 waiting/in-progress/failed/unknown/success 与可见 label。只有 in-progress 可提供 {value, min?, max}；max 是调用方已知分母，null 为不定进度。
props.descriptionEn: Caller-provided waiting/in-progress/failed/unknown/success and a visible label. Only in-progress accepts {value,min?,max}; max is a known denominator and null is indeterminate.

props.name: renderFileActions
props.description: 应用的实际恢复/核对入口，组件不自动执行；本地移除不表示取消上传或删除服务端对象。
props.descriptionEn: Real application recovery/check actions, never executed automatically. Local removal does not imply canceling an upload or deleting a server object.

props.name: inputProps / render / ref / ARIA / events
props.description: 选择动作与编辑边界共用一套几何（跟随密度轴）；Input 出口支持 render/ref/events。required 不暴露，chooser 会清空；集合必填由应用按当前 value 校验并用 FieldError 表达。
props.descriptionEn: The chooser shares one geometry with the editing boundary (density axis). Input supports render, refs, and events. required is not exposed because the chooser clears; validate the current set in the application with FieldError.

api.name: FileUploadPrimitive
api.description: 所用安装版 Input 原语命名空间。
api.descriptionEn: The installed Input primitive namespace.

keyboard.description: 到真实原生文件入口并选择；只读阻止修改。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Reach and activate the real native file chooser; read-only blocks changes.

keyboard.description: 移除已接受本地文件或关闭拒绝提示；应用恢复入口遵守其自身事实。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Remove accepted local files or dismiss rejections; recovery actions follow application facts.

notes: 对象身份决定集合成员；不凭同名/大小猜文件内容相同。移除后可重新选择同一文件；聚焦行移除回相邻动作或 chooser，受控拒绝不夺焦点。
Field 保留 Label/error/disabled 连接；实际 chooser 的 name/value/required 隔离，避免提交草稿或恒 invalid。
需要支持 formdata 的浏览器；jsdom 事件桥接不等于已验证原生 FormData 构造行为。
规则值是应用约束，列表/拖放布局是选择，样式读现有角色，无额外数值 token。
选择入口只显示操作名称，原生 chooser 清空用于重选；已接受文件事实以独立集合呈现。装饰 span 不创建第二交互入口。
notesEn: Object identity determines membership; equal names/sizes do not imply equal content. Removed files can be reselected. Removing a focused row returns to a neighboring action or chooser; controlled refusal preserves focus.
Field retains label/error/disabled links. The actual chooser isolates name, value, and required to avoid draft submission or permanent invalidity.
Requires browser formdata support. A jsdom event bridge does not verify native FormData construction.
Rules are application constraints; list/drop layout is a choice. Styles use existing roles without new numeric tokens.
The chooser displays its action name and clears for reselection. The separate list expresses accepted files. Its decorative span creates no second interaction entry.

composition: Field + FieldLabel + FileUpload + 实际规则说明/FieldError

library: 选择、拖放、非受控本地集合、真实拒绝
application: 受控集合、接受规则、上传状态/进度、恢复与结果

responsive: 原生 Input/Button 一套几何，跟随密度轴，紧凑不缩小文字，文件名按真实容量换行
customization: Input/根 render/ref/ARIA/events、getStatus、恢复入口及现有主题

composition: Field + FieldLabel + FileUpload + actual rule explanation/FieldError

library: Selection, drop, uncontrolled local collection, and actual rejection.
application: Controlled collection, acceptance rules, upload state/progress, recovery, and outcomes.

responsive: Native Input/Button use five matching text profiles; filenames wrap within actual capacity.
customization: Input/root render/refs/ARIA/events, getStatus, recovery entries, and existing theme.

props.name: render / ref / native props
props.description: 属性和 ref 归属实际元素；调用方事件与样式保留。

avoid: 不要把草稿数量当作已应用结果数量。

library: 原生提交、fieldset 禁用与状态标记。
application: 草稿、已应用条件、结果、计数和异步执行。

responsive: 桌面保持真实结构；菜单受可用空间限制，表格保留完整比较列。
customization: 控件档案、间距和浮层表面消费现有角色；具体外观是预设。

whenToUse: Several conditions need explicit apply/cancel boundaries.
avoid: Treating draft condition counts as applied result counts.

library: Native submission, fieldset disabling, and state markers.
application: Drafts, applied conditions, results, counts, and asynchronous execution.

responsive: Keep actual desktop structure; menus fit available space and tables retain complete comparison columns.
customization: Control profiles, spacing, and popup surfaces consume existing roles; their appearance is a preset.

metadata.title: 表单 Form
metadata.description: 原生字段提交范围与重置上下文。
metadata.descriptionEn: A native field submission scope and reset context.
metadata.decisions: Form 不推断校验或提交结果。应用使用原生 onSubmit 与 FormData，显式给 Field.invalid 和就地 FieldError；失败或取消不自动清空输入。
metadata.decisionsEn: Form infers no validation or submission outcome. Use native onSubmit and FormData, with explicit Field.invalid and local FieldError; failure or cancellation never clears input automatically.

whenToUse: 字段需要一个真实提交或重置范围。
avoid: 把容器当作保存服务、成功状态或自动校验上下文。
composition: Field / Fieldset 命名字段和范围；FieldGroup 或布局组件安排关系；Button 明确声明 type。

library: 原生表单元素与组合入口。
application: 草稿、显式校验、请求、外部错误与结果。

responsive: Form 不强加围合或字段布局。
customization: 原生属性与事件、render、className、style 和 ref 属于实际 form。

whenToUse: Fields need an actual submission or reset scope.
avoid: Treating a container as a saving service, success state, or automatic validation context.
composition: Field/Fieldset name fields and scopes; FieldGroup or layout components organize relationships. Button declares type explicitly.

library: The native form element and composition entry.
application: Drafts, explicit validation, requests, external errors, and outcomes.

responsive: Form imposes neither enclosure nor field layout.
customization: Native props/events, render, className, style, and refs belong to the actual form.

api.name: Form
api.description: 真实原生 form，无内置请求和错误聚合。
api.descriptionEn: A real native form with no request or error aggregation.

props.name: onSubmit / onReset
props.description: 原生事件，支持 preventDefault；提交值由应用使用 FormData 读取。
props.descriptionEn: Native events with preventDefault; the application reads values using FormData.

props.name: action / method / noValidate / id / name
props.description: 保留平台提交与约束校验；不默认关闭 constraint validation。
props.descriptionEn: Keeps platform submission and constraints; native validation remains enabled by default.

props.name: render / ref / ARIA / className / style
props.description: 保留原生组合。render 必须继续承载实际表单语义。
props.descriptionEn: Native composition props; render must keep actual form semantics.

keyboard.description: 按平台规则进行隐式提交；原生约束可阻止无效值提交。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Implicit submission follows platform rules; native constraints can block invalid values.

notes: FieldError.errors 是调用方给出的错误，Field.invalid 单独由调用方声明。
notesEn: FieldError.errors contains caller-provided messages; Field.invalid is separately declared by the caller.

provenance.scope: Current library authorship classification; this generator does not perform independent provenance comparison.

metadata.title: 两维度的量 Heatmap
metadata.description: 两个类别维度上的量，例如「星期 × 时段」的同步热度；单色顺序色阶（第一色由淡到足），可聚焦的格与按需展开的数据表。
metadata.descriptionEn: A quantity over two categorical dimensions, such as sync activity by weekday and hour; a single-hue sequential scale (the first series color, light to full), focusable cells and an on-demand data table.
metadata.decisions: 行列都是类别轴，不是数据系列——没有身份要区分，只有量的大小，因此只用一种色相：数据是色，取第一色（花青）与纸调和的 12% 到足色。未知/不适用格用清墨斜线纹，不进色阶，避免与真实的小量值混淆。
metadata.decisionsEn: Rows and columns are both categorical axes, not data series — there is no identity to distinguish, only magnitude, so it uses one hue: data is color, the first series color (huaqing) mixed with paper from 12% to full. Unknown/not-applicable cells carry a diagonal ink hatch instead of a scale step, so they are never mistaken for a small real value.

api.name: Heatmap
api.description: figure 名称、两个命名的类别轴、单色顺序色阶的网格与同源可见 Table。
api.descriptionEn: A named figure, two named categorical axes, a single-hue sequential grid and a visible same-source Table.

props.name: label
props.description: 非空真实语义名称。
props.descriptionEn: A nonempty semantic name for the actual data.

props.name: rowLabel / columnLabel / valueLabel
props.description: 行维度、列维度与量各自的名字，例如「时段」「星期」「同步次数」。
props.descriptionEn: Names for the row dimension, column dimension and the measured quantity, e.g. "hour", "weekday", "syncs".

props.name: columns
props.description: 列维度的取值，2 个以上——与数据系列不同，没有身份色上限。
props.descriptionEn: The column dimension's values, two or more — unlike a data series, there is no identity-color cap.

props.name: rows
props.description: 行维度的取值，2 个以上；每行必须对每个 column.key 给出 finite number 或 {state, label}。
props.descriptionEn: The row dimension's values, two or more; every row must supply a finite number or {state, label} for every column key.

props.name: formatValue
props.description: 格式化已知数值；默认按 UILocale 数值 Intl。
props.descriptionEn: Format known values; defaults to Intl number formatting for UILocale.

notes: 每个格都可聚焦，aria-label 直接给出行、列与数值或未知原因，不依赖悬停就能读到。
悬停/聚焦读数只增强，不替代可聚焦格自身的名称与数据表。
相邻格之间 2px 纸色空隙，与柱状、堆叠柱同一机制。
少于两行或两列会抛出错误：那是 Chart 的 bar，不是网格。
notesEn: Every cell is focusable; its aria-label states the row, column and value or unavailable reason directly, reachable without hovering.
Hover/focus readouts only enhance; they never replace the focusable cell's own name or the data table.
Adjacent cells carry the same 2px surface-color gap as bars and stacked bars.
Fewer than two rows or columns throws: that is a Chart bar, not a grid.

whenToUse: 两个类别维度组合出的量需要一眼看出热度分布，例如一周内各时段的同步次数。
avoid: 只有一个类别维度（用 Chart bar）；需要精确读出每个数值而不是找热点（用数据表或 Chart）。
composition: 手写 CSS 网格 + 当前 Table；复用 Chart 的 readValue 取值契约。没有可画的数据时，调用方在原位改放 Empty。

library: 网格着色、可聚焦名称、可见等价表与基础校验。
application: 数据、量纲与真实性。

responsive: 网格随可用宽度收缩，超宽时横向滚动；表格原生滚动/换行。
customization: 第一色的顺序色阶；不另造热力图调色板。

whenToUse: A quantity formed by two categorical dimensions needs an at-a-glance heat pattern, e.g. sync counts by hour across a week.
avoid: Only one categorical dimension (use Chart bar); reading every exact value rather than spotting hot spots (use a data table or Chart).
composition: A hand-built CSS grid with the current Table; reuses Chart's readValue contract. With nothing to plot, the caller renders Empty in place of the heatmap.

library: Grid coloring, focusable naming, the visible equivalent table and basic validation.
application: Data, units and truth.

responsive: The grid shrinks with available width and scrolls horizontally when it would overflow; the table scrolls and wraps natively.
customization: The first series color's sequential scale; no separate heatmap palette.

provenance.scope: Current library authorship classification; this generator does not perform independent provenance comparison.

metadata.title: 链接预览 HoverCard
metadata.description: 悬停与键盘焦点展开相同补充内容。
metadata.descriptionEn: Reveal the same supplemental content on hover and keyboard focus.
metadata.decisions: 默认触发是可到达链接；补充内容不唯一承载后果，Tab 主动离开时不抢回焦点。
metadata.decisionsEn: Use a reachable link by default. Supplemental content cannot carry the only consequence information; do not reclaim focus after deliberate navigation.

api.name: HoverCard
api.description: Base UI PreviewCard 公共 Root，保留 open/defaultOpen/onOpenChange、payload、handle 和 closeDelay。
api.descriptionEn: Public Base UI PreviewCard Root, retaining open/defaultOpen/onOpenChange, payload, handle, and closeDelay.

api.name: HoverCardTrigger
api.description: 真实可到达入口与键盘同源预览。
api.descriptionEn: An actual reachable entry with a keyboard-accessible preview from the same source.

props.name: href
props.description: 原生链接要求非空真实目标；自定义 render 须提供等价键盘可达性。
props.descriptionEn: Native links need nonblank real targets; custom render must provide equivalent keyboard access.

props.name: delay
props.description: 悬停进入时延；即时为当前选择，focus 仍由原语管理。
props.descriptionEn: Hover entry delay; immediate is the current choice, while the primitive still manages focus.

props.name: render / ref / className / style
props.description: 保留原语组合和状态回调。
props.descriptionEn: Retain primitive composition and state callbacks.

api.name: HoverCardPopup
api.description: 自身定位上下文的补充内容。
api.descriptionEn: Supplementary content with its own positioning context.

props.name: side / align / sideOffset / alignOffset / anchor
props.description: 采用自身公开定位上下文。
props.descriptionEn: Uses its own public positioning context.

props.name: portalProps / positionerProps
props.description: 容器、ref、render、事件和样式透传；共享 popup 层级先合并，调用方 style 最后合并。
props.descriptionEn: Forwards containers, refs, render, events, and styles; shared popup layers merge first, caller style last.

keyboard.description: 焦点到链接时展开；主动移开不抢回。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Focus on the link opens the preview; moving away never reclaims focus.

keyboard.description: 结束预览。
keyboard.descriptionEn: End the preview.

keyboard.description: 到达链接目标。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Follow the link target.

notes: 关键后果也必须在持续可见的位置可达。
需要执行局部动作时按任务选择 Popover。
透明边界、面、文字和入退复用公共角色；没有虚构对象或请求。
notesEn: Critical consequences must also remain reachable in a persistent location.
Choose Popover when the task needs local actions.
Transparent boundaries, surfaces, text, and motion use public roles; no invented objects or requests.

whenToUse: 链接需要同源、可键盘到达的补充预览。
avoid: 唯一重要信息只在 hover 时出现。
composition: 真实链接与补充内容；独立 Positioner 消费共享层级。

library: 悬停/focus 状态、定位与退出。
application: 链接目标、真实内容与后果。

responsive: 长内容换行，容量受原语 available width/height 限制。
customization: surface-raised、panel-padding-sm、文字角色与 motion.css。

whenToUse: A link needs a keyboard-accessible supplementary preview from the same source.
avoid: Important information available only on hover.
composition: An actual link with supplementary content; an independent Positioner consumes shared layers.

library: Hover/focus states, positioning, and exit.
application: Link targets, actual content, and consequences.

responsive: Long content wraps; primitive available width/height constrain capacity.
customization: surface-raised, panel-padding-sm, text roles, and motion.css.

provenance.scope: Current library authorship classification; this generator does not perform independent provenance comparison.

metadata.title: 输入组合 InputGroup
metadata.description: 让输入与标记、单位或附属动作共用编辑边界。
metadata.descriptionEn: Give an input and its markers, units or actions one editing boundary.
metadata.decisions: InputGroupInput 复用 Input 的 unstyled 出口。静态附件不抢焦点；需要动作时用 InputGroupButton，它与输入共用同一条外边界、自己不画框，并保留动作自己的名称与状态。清空、显示密码这类动作不内置在输入框里，都由这里组合；SearchInput 与 PasswordInput 就是这样搭出来的。
metadata.decisionsEn: InputGroupInput uses Input's unstyled outlet. Static addons do not redirect focus; use InputGroupButton for actions: it shares the outer boundary, draws no frame of its own, and keeps its own name and state. Clearing and password visibility are not built into Input; they are composed here, which is how SearchInput and PasswordInput are built.

whenToUse: 输入与单位、标记或附属动作属于同一编辑范围。
avoid: 把无关动作附在输入上；只靠附件或 Placeholder 命名输入。
composition: FieldLabel 命名输入；附件的必要说明由 aria-describedby 显式关联。搜索与密码已有现成组合 SearchInput、PasswordInput。

library: 共同边界、几何接线及 Input 的原生交互。
application: 输入值、附件动作、名称及校验事实。

responsive: 输入占剩余宽度；边界与内部 Input 一套几何，跟随密度轴，紧凑不缩小文字，粗指针目标单独保持。
customization: root 样式属于共同边界，Input 的 className/style/render/ref 属于实际输入；附件有独立 render。

whenToUse: An input shares one editing scope with units, markers, or adjunct actions.
avoid: Unrelated actions attached to an input; naming the input through an adjunct or placeholder alone.
composition: FieldLabel names the input; aria-describedby explicitly associates necessary adjunct explanations. SearchInput and PasswordInput are ready-made compositions for search and passwords.

library: Shared boundary, geometry wiring, and Input's native interaction.
application: Input values, adjunct actions, names, and validation facts.

responsive: Input takes remaining width; boundary and inner Input share one geometry following the density axis, while coarse-pointer targets remain separate.
customization: Root styles own the shared boundary. Input className/style/render/refs own the actual input; adjuncts have independent render.

api.name: InputGroup
api.description: 共同编辑边界，不自动建立另一个字段角色。
api.descriptionEn: A shared editing boundary with no extra field role.

props.name: render / ref / 原生属性
props.description: 共同边界组合入口。
props.descriptionEn: Composition props for the common boundary.

api.name: InputGroupInput
api.description: Input 的 unstyled 组合，尺寸来自组。
api.descriptionEn: Input's unstyled composition with the group's size.

props.name: InputProps（除 size / unstyled）
props.description: 保留原生输入、受控值、nativeInput 与实际输入 ref。
props.descriptionEn: Retains native input props, controlled values, nativeInput and the actual input ref.

api.name: InputGroupAddon
api.description: 默认静态 span；不添加 tabIndex、聚焦处理或自动名称。
api.descriptionEn: A static span by default, with no tabIndex, focus redirection or automatic name.

props.name: render / ref / 原生属性
props.description: 单位、前缀、图标等静态内容的承载位。
props.descriptionEn: A position for static content: units, prefixes, icons.

api.name: InputGroupButton
api.description: 编辑边界内的动作：不画自己的框，铺满边界内高；图标形为内高见方。
api.descriptionEn: An action inside the editing boundary: no frame of its own, filling the inner height; the icon shape is an inner-height square.

props.name: shape
props.description: 图标形需要 aria-label。
props.descriptionEn: The icon shape requires aria-label.

props.name: variant
props.description: 边界内默认无框。
props.descriptionEn: Frameless inside the boundary by default.

props.name: 其余 ButtonProps
props.description: loading、disabled、onClick、render 等与 Button 相同。
props.descriptionEn: loading, disabled, onClick, render and the rest behave as on Button.

notes: FieldControl 注册组合时传 InputGroupInput nativeInput，避免重复注册。
禁用输入不意味着禁用任意附属动作；应用应声明每个动作的真实状态。
notesEn: Use InputGroupInput nativeInput when FieldControl registers the composition, avoiding duplicate registration.
Disabling the input does not disable arbitrary addon actions; the application declares each action's real state.

provenance.scope: Current library authorship classification; this generator does not perform independent provenance comparison.

metadata.title: 输入框 Input
metadata.description: 输入一个文本值。
metadata.descriptionEn: Enter one text value.
metadata.decisions: 输入框只做一件事：承载一个值的输入。清空、搜索图标与显示密码是附在编辑边界上的另一件事，由 SearchInput、PasswordInput 或 InputGroup 组合出来，输入框不内置。Placeholder 不能代替持续可见的名称。
metadata.decisionsEn: Input does one thing: it carries the entry of one value. Clearing, a search icon and password visibility are a separate matter on the editing boundary, composed by SearchInput, PasswordInput or InputGroup rather than built into Input. A placeholder does not replace a persistent visible name.

whenToUse: 输入一个文本值，原生 type 与内容匹配。
avoid: 搜索用 SearchInput，密码用 PasswordInput。
用 placeholder 代替名称；把超时变成无效；把未知转成空串或 0；校验失败清空草稿。
composition: 与 FieldLabel、FieldDescription、FieldError 共处；单位、标记与附属动作（清空、应用）交给 InputGroup + InputGroupButton。

library: 原生输入、Field 关联、焦点与只读标记。
application: 值的含义、校验事实、候选范围、未知/不适用及送达结果。

responsive: xs/sm/md/lg/xl 消费基础层档案；窄屏增加 4px，粗指针编辑区至少 44px。
customization: className、style、render 与 ref 属于真实 input；controlClassName 属于编辑边界。

whenToUse: Enter one text value with a matching native type.
avoid: Use SearchInput for search and PasswordInput for passwords.
Placeholders replacing names; timeouts treated as invalid; unknown converted to empty or zero; drafts cleared after validation failure.
composition: Keep FieldLabel, FieldDescription, and FieldError together; InputGroup + InputGroupButton supply units, markers, and adjunct actions such as clearing or applying.

library: Native input, Field associations, focus, and the read-only marker.
application: Value meaning, validation facts, candidate scope, unknown/not-applicable values, and delivery outcomes.

responsive: xs/sm/md/lg/xl use foundation profiles; narrow heights add 4px and coarse-pointer editing areas are at least 44px.
customization: className, style, render, and refs belong to the actual input; controlClassName belongs to its editing boundary.

api.name: Input
api.description: 真实边框界定编辑区；Base UI Input 保留 Field 注册和原生属性。
api.descriptionEn: A real border identifies the editable area. Base UI Input retains Field registration and native attributes.

props.name: type
props.description: 原生类型原样生效，不附带任何额外动作。搜索与密码用 SearchInput / PasswordInput。
props.descriptionEn: The native type applies as is, with no extra action attached. Use SearchInput / PasswordInput for search and passwords.

props.name: value / defaultValue / onValueChange
props.type: 原生值 / 初始值 / (value, details) => void
props.typeEn: Native value / initial value / (value, details) => void
props.description: 支持受控与非受控值；onChange 同样透传。
props.descriptionEn: Controlled and uncontrolled values; onChange is also forwarded.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: 保留焦点、复制与表单提交，阻止编辑；默认显示只读标记。
props.descriptionEn: Retains focus, copying, and form submission while blocking edits. Shows a read-only marker.

props.name: className / style / render / ref
props.description: 全部作用于真实 input；className/style 支持状态函数。
props.descriptionEn: Applied to the real input. className/style support state functions.

props.name: controlClassName
props.description: 调整共同编辑边界，例如宽度与所在布局；不替代原生属性。
props.descriptionEn: Styles the shared editable boundary, including its width and placement.

props.name: unstyled
props.description: 由 InputGroup 等公共组合承担边界；保留内高、档案与原生状态。
props.descriptionEn: Lets a public composition such as InputGroup supply the boundary while retaining inner geometry and native state.

props.name: nativeInput
props.description: 已由 FieldControl 或其他原语注册时使用原生出口；保留 render/ref/事件，避免重复注册。
props.descriptionEn: Native outlet for an input already registered by FieldControl or another primitive. Retains render, refs, and events without double registration.

keyboard.description: 进入与离开输入。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Enter and leave the input.

notes: aria-invalid 来自应用或浏览器校验；值的真伪与是否送达分开表达。
提供 FieldLabel、原生 label 或 aria-label。Placeholder 是输入提示，不是名称。
clearable / clearLabel / onClear 与 visibilityToggle / visible / defaultVisible / onVisibleChange / showLabel 已移除：搜索用 SearchInput，密码用 PasswordInput，其他附属动作用 InputGroup + InputGroupButton 组合。
type="file" 保留浏览器文件选择行为与语言；文件列表和业务校验由调用方提供。
notesEn: aria-invalid comes from application or browser validation. Value validity and delivery are separate facts.
Provide FieldLabel, a native label, or aria-label. A placeholder is a hint rather than a name.

clearable / clearLabel / onClear and visibilityToggle / visible / defaultVisible / onVisibleChange / showLabel are removed: use SearchInput for search, PasswordInput for passwords, and compose InputGroup + InputGroupButton for other adjunct actions.
type="file" retains browser behavior and language. The caller owns file lists and business validation.

provenance.scope: Current library authorship classification; this generator does not perform independent provenance comparison.

metadata.title: 条目 Item
metadata.description: 内容、入口与附属动作的关系。
metadata.descriptionEn: Content, navigation and related actions.
metadata.decisions: 条目不内建业务对象。整体链接不包含其他交互动作；有附属动作时链接与按钮保持兄弟关系。
metadata.decisionsEn: Items contain no built-in business objects. A whole-item link cannot contain interactive controls; separate links and buttons when secondary actions exist.

whenToUse: 一个通用条目需要名称、补充内容与相关动作。
avoid: 多维比较使用 Table；不为没有目的的条目生成链接。

library: 条目关系、render 转发与焦点。
application: 条目内容、真实导航目标与操作状态。

responsive: 正文可换行，附属动作保留容量。

whenToUse: A general item needs a name, supplementary content, and related actions.
avoid: Use Table for multidimensional comparison; do not create links without an actual destination.

library: Item relationships, render forwarding, and focus.
application: Item content, actual navigation targets, and action states.

responsive: Body text wraps while adjunct actions retain capacity.

api.name: Item
api.description: 默认 div，可 render 为 li 或独立 a。
api.descriptionEn: A div that may render a li or standalone anchor.

props.name: render / ref / children / native props
props.description: 实际元素接收事件与 ref；列表中显式 render 为 li。
props.descriptionEn: Events and ref reach the actual element; explicitly render li inside a list.

api.name: ItemContent / ItemTitle / ItemDescription / ItemActions
api.description: div / div / p / div 关系槽。
api.descriptionEn: div / div / p / div relationship slots.

props.name: children / render / ref / native props
props.description: 标题不是默认章节标题；动作组合公共 Button。
props.descriptionEn: The title is not automatically a document heading; compose public Button actions.

api.name: ItemLink
api.description: 真实导航链接。
api.descriptionEn: A real navigation link.

props.name: href / render / ref / native props
props.description: 保留目标、ARIA 和消费者事件。
props.descriptionEn: Preserve destinations, ARIA and caller events.

keyboard.description: 实际链接与按钮沿用原生顺序。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Actual links and buttons use native focus order.

notes: 不在 a 中嵌套按钮、链接或其他交互控件；无需动作时不生成假入口。

metadata.title: 动效策略 MotionProvider

api.name: MotionProvider
api.description: 无界面组件。挂载时把 data-ui-input 设为 pointer；捕获到 keydown 改为 keyboard，pointerdown 或 pointermove 改回 pointer；卸载时还原。属性写在 <html> 上，因此也覆盖传送到 body 的浮层。
api.descriptionEn: No visible UI. Mount sets data-ui-input to pointer; captured keydown switches to keyboard, pointerdown/pointermove to pointer. Unmount restores the previous value. The html attribute also covers body Portals.

props.name: children
props.description: 应用内容。
props.descriptionEn: Application content.

notes: 只在应用根部挂载一次；示例复用本站根部的 MotionProvider。
motion.css 读取 data-ui-input；键盘下过渡时长归零，指针下保留过渡。

motion.css reads data-ui-input, skipping transitions for keyboard input and retaining them for pointer input.
motion.css handles the system reduced-motion preference independently of input modality.
data-instant skips an element's transition. Custom parts use data-slot or qy-pressable for the shared policy.
metadata.decisions: 键盘与减少动态效果会跳过部分过渡。状态直接更新，不依赖动画结束。

application: Business state timing, root assembly, and whether programmatic changes need animation.

responsive: Layouts and animation permit interruption; keyboard and system reduced motion are checked separately.

props.name: render / ref / native props

metadata.title: 数值输入 NumberField
metadata.description: 编辑可为空的数值，并按指定步长增减。
metadata.descriptionEn: Edit an optional number and adjust it by a declared step.
metadata.decisions: 直接编辑超出范围时保留原值，提交由浏览器范围约束检查；步进仍限制在 min/max。空、负号和未完成小数不会被替换为 0。
metadata.decisionsEn: Direct edits outside the range remain intact for native range validation. Stepping still respects min/max. Empty, minus, and partial decimal drafts are not replaced with zero.

api.name: NumberField
api.description: 数值与编辑文本的原语上下文。
api.descriptionEn: Primitive context for the numeric value and its editable text.

props.name: value / defaultValue / onValueChange
props.description: null 表示空；受控值由调用方接受，details 支持 cancel()。
props.descriptionEn: null means empty. The caller accepts controlled changes; details supports cancel().

props.name: min / max / step
props.description: 范围约束直接编辑与表单校验，步进夹在范围内；step='any' 关闭步长校验，交互仍按 1 增减。显式 min 与 step 才始终启用步长提交校验。
props.descriptionEn: Native range validation preserves direct edits; stepping clamps to the range. step='any' disables step validation and steps by one. Explicit min with step always enables submission step validation.

props.name: snapOnStep / smallStep / largeStep
props.description: 是否吸附与 Alt/Shift 步长是独立的显式选项。
props.descriptionEn: Snapping and Alt/Shift step sizes are explicit independent options.

props.name: onValueCommitted
props.description: blur 或步进提交回调，只描述编辑结束，不代表已保存。
props.descriptionEn: A blur or stepping commit reports the end of editing, not persistence.

props.name: name / form / required / disabled / readOnly
props.description: 原生表单与语义入口；只读继续参与提交，禁用不提交。
props.descriptionEn: Native form semantics. Read-only values submit; disabled values do not.

props.name: locale / format
props.description: 显式数字格式；未指定精度时不因聚焦/失焦丢弃外部数值精度。
props.descriptionEn: Explicit number formatting. Without rounding options, focus and blur preserve external precision.

api.name: NumberFieldGroup
api.description: 输入与两个步进共享的边界；render/ref/样式与状态透传。
api.descriptionEn: Shared boundary for the input and two steppers; forwards render, refs, styling, and state.

api.name: NumberFieldInput
api.description: 复用 Input 的原生出口，由数值原语注册一次 Field。
api.descriptionEn: Composes the native Input outlet while the number primitive registers Field once.

props.name: render / ref / className / style / ARIA / events
props.description: 属于真实 input；render 状态保留数值、编辑文本等 NumberField 状态。
props.descriptionEn: Applied to the real input. Render retains numeric value, draft text, and other NumberField state.

api.name: NumberFieldDecrement / NumberFieldIncrement
api.description: 减少/增加原语复用 quiet Button；内建名称来自 locale，按钮不提交表单。
api.descriptionEn: Decrease/increase primitives compose quiet Button. Locale names and non-submitting buttons.

api.name: NumberFieldPrimitive
api.description: 所用 Base UI NumberField 命名空间。
api.descriptionEn: The installed Base UI NumberField namespace.

keyboard.description: 按步长增减；不因直接编辑允许超范围而越过步进边界。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Step up or down within the stepping bounds.

keyboard.description: 使用 smallStep / largeStep。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Use smallStep / largeStep.

keyboard.description: 按文档顺序移动数值入口；步进按钮点击后保留输入焦点，键盘步进在输入上执行。只读仍可聚焦文本。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Move among numeric inputs. Stepper clicks retain input focus; keyboard stepping acts on that input. Read-only text remains focusable.

notes: FieldLabel 命名真实输入，FieldDescription 明示范围与步长。
封装固定 allowOutOfRange=true；没有静默纠正直接编辑的入口。
不从范围外值自动判断保存失败；invalid 由应用提供。
新写的共同边界与五档样式是本次视觉变化，浏览器焦点/对比另验。
notesEn: FieldLabel names the real input; FieldDescription states range and step.
The wrapper fixes allowOutOfRange=true and does not silently correct direct edits.
An out-of-range value is not a save failure. The caller provides invalid.
This rebuild changes the shared boundary and size profiles. Browser focus and contrast require separate checks.

whenToUse: 有数值含义并需要步进的值
avoid: 编号、验证码、前导零有意义的文本用 Input / OtpField
composition: Field + FieldLabel + NumberField / Group / Input / steppers + FieldDescription / Error

library: 编辑文本、步进、焦点、非受控数值
application: 受控数值、范围、无效事实与提交结果

responsive: 一套几何，跟随密度轴，紧凑不缩小文字与窄屏 +4px；粗指针编辑/步进采用库内触摸目标
customization: Root 与每部件支持 render/ref；集中角色决定表面与尺寸

whenToUse: A value has numeric meaning and needs stepping.
avoid: Use Input/OtpField for identifiers, verification codes, or text with meaningful leading zeros.
composition: Field + FieldLabel + NumberField / Group / Input / steppers + FieldDescription / Error

library: Editing text, stepping, focus, and uncontrolled numeric values.
application: Controlled numeric values, ranges, invalid facts, and submission outcomes.

responsive: Five matching text profiles and narrow-screen +4px; coarse-pointer editing/stepping use the library's touch target.
customization: Root and parts expose render/refs; central roles determine surfaces and dimensions.

provenance.scope: Current library authorship classification; this generator does not perform independent provenance comparison.

metadata.title: 分段文本 OtpField
metadata.description: 分段呈现一个固定长度文本值。
metadata.descriptionEn: Present a fixed-length text value in segments.
metadata.decisions: 只有一个真实文本输入，分段跟随它的光标与选择。前导零保留，长度填满只说明文本长度；核对、请求和结果归应用。
metadata.decisionsEn: One real text input owns the caret and selection. Leading zeros remain intact. Filling the length reports no verification result; the application owns checking and requests.

api.name: OtpField
api.description: Input 的分段呈现，Field 注册一次。
api.descriptionEn: Segmented presentation of Input with one Field registration.

props.name: length
props.description: 必填正整数，以 Unicode code point 计。超长用户插入整次拒绝并说明；外部值完整呈现，不截断。
props.descriptionEn: Required positive integer, counted as Unicode code points. Over-capacity insertions are rejected whole with feedback. External values are shown in full.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: 受控或非受控文本，保留前导零。
props.descriptionEn: Controlled or uncontrolled text; leading zeros remain.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: 请求文本变化；受控调用方拒绝更新时原值不变。
props.descriptionEn: Requests a text change. A controlled caller may retain the previous value.

props.name: inputMode / autoComplete
props.description: inputMode 由真实字符范围决定；type 始终 text，不自动转换为数值。
props.descriptionEn: Choose inputMode for the character set. The input type remains text.

props.name: render / ref / className / style / ARIA / events
props.description: 全部属于真实 input；render 必须保持 input 语义、受控值和事件。
props.descriptionEn: Applied to the real input. Render must retain input semantics, its controlled value, and events.

props.name: controlClassName
props.description: 调整分段容器的位置与布局。
props.descriptionEn: Styles the segmented container's placement and layout.

props.name: disabled / readOnly / name / form / required
props.description: 禁用不提交；只读可聚焦、复制与提交。
props.descriptionEn: Disabled text does not submit. Read-only text remains focusable, copyable, and submitted.

keyboard.description: 替换原生选择并推进光标；粘贴超出容量时保留原文。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Replace the native selection and advance the caret; over-capacity paste preserves the original text.

keyboard.description: 移动原生文本光标；Shift 保留原生文本选择。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Move the native caret; Shift extends native selection.

keyboard.description: 按原生光标或选择删除文本。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Delete according to the native caret or selection.

keyboard.description: 整个字段只有一个焦点入口。
keyboard.descriptionEn: The whole field has one focus stop.

notes: 点击一段选中该字符，后续输入替换它；空段将光标放在当前文本末尾。
与 FieldLabel、FieldDescription、FieldError 共处；分段本身对辅助技术隐藏。
本批采用单输入分段结构，不恢复旧分段 API。
真实移动端自动填充、IME、辅助技术与焦点对比仍需浏览器/设备验证。
notesEn: Clicking a segment selects its character. An empty segment places the caret at the end.
Compose with FieldLabel, FieldDescription, and FieldError. Visual segments are hidden from assistive tech.
This rebuild chooses one segmented input and does not restore a prior segmented API.
Mobile autofill, real IME, assistive tech, and focus contrast need browser/device verification.

whenToUse: 任务明确给出长度的短文本
avoid: 数值步进用 NumberField；不确定长度用 Input
composition: Field 持有持续名称、说明和错误；不内建登录业务

library: 文本草稿、光标、选择与容量拒绝提示
application: 长度、字符规则、受控值、核对与提交结果

responsive: 分段使用同档 control/text；超出外部值完整显示，容器可由项目调整
customization: 输入 props 属于真实 input；controlClassName 属于外容器

whenToUse: The task specifies a short text length.
avoid: Use NumberField for numeric stepping and Input for unspecified lengths.
composition: Field supplies persistent names, descriptions, and errors; no built-in sign-in business logic.

library: Text drafts, caret, selection, and capacity rejection feedback.
application: Length, character rules, controlled values, verification, and submission outcomes.

responsive: Segments use matching control/text profiles; over-capacity external values display fully, with consumer-adjustable containers.
customization: Input props belong to the actual input; controlClassName belongs to the outer container.

metadata.title: 页面标题 PageHeader
metadata.description: 页面名称、上下文与相关动作共置。
metadata.descriptionEn: Co-locate a page name, context and related actions.
metadata.decisions: header 按任务关系共置内容；无自动面包屑、路由或维护者标签。标题层级独立于视觉文字档。
metadata.decisionsEn: A header co-locates task-related content without automatic breadcrumbs, routing or maintainer labels. Heading level is independent of visual scale.

whenToUse: 页面名称和与本任务有关的动作需要共置。
avoid: 普通章节标题使用 Heading；持续的成组操作使用 Toolbar。

library: 标题、上下文与动作的关系布局。
application: 页面名称、标题层级、内容事实与动作可用性。

responsive: 标题与动作可换行，保留原生焦点顺序。

whenToUse: A page name and actions for its current task need to appear together.
avoid: Use Heading for ordinary section titles and Toolbar for persistent grouped operations.

library: Relationship layout for titles, context, and actions.
application: Page names, heading levels, content facts, and action availability.

responsive: Titles and actions wrap while retaining native focus order.

api.name: PageHeader
api.description: 原生 header。
api.descriptionEn: A native header.

props.name: children / render / ref / native props
props.description: 结构、ARIA、ref 与事件传入实际 header。
props.descriptionEn: Structure, ARIA, refs and events reach the actual header.

api.name: PageHeaderContent / PageHeaderDescription / PageHeaderActions
api.description: div / p / div 内容槽。
api.descriptionEn: div / p / div content slots.

props.name: children / render / ref / native props
props.description: 应用提供上下文与真实操作，动作使用公共 Button 或链接。

api.name: PageHeaderTitle
api.description: 复用 Heading。
api.descriptionEn: A Heading composition.

props.name: level / step / render / ref / Heading props
props.description: 嵌入章节时调整 level；文字尺度是既有预设。
props.descriptionEn: Adjust level for nested sections; text scale is an existing preset.

notes: 无需动作时省略动作槽；不复制已经明确的路径或操作说明。

metadata.title: 分页 Pagination
metadata.description: 页位置、真实入口与明确的未知总数。
metadata.descriptionEn: Page position, real actions and explicit unknown totals.
metadata.decisions: 只从 root page 与 link page 相等推导当前位置。总页数 null 表示未知；不创建末页或推断下一页存在。
metadata.decisionsEn: Only current position is derived by comparing root and link page facts. null means an unknown total; no final page or next-page availability is inferred.

whenToUse: 结果按页呈现，页位置和方向可用性已知。
avoid: 过程进度用 Steps；不确定结果总数时不伪造末页。

library: 页入口的导航、列表、当前页语义与真实禁用。
application: 页内容、当前页、总数或未知、前后页可用性与请求结果。

responsive: 动作可换行，保留当前页与总数状态。

whenToUse: Results are paged and positions/navigation availability are known.
avoid: Use Steps for process progression; never invent a last page when totals are unknown.

library: Navigation, lists, current-page semantics, and actual disabling of page entries.
application: Page content, current page, known/unknown totals, previous/next availability, and request outcomes.

responsive: Actions wrap while retaining current-page and total states.

api.name: Pagination
api.description: 有名称的 nav，不生成页码。
api.descriptionEn: A named nav without generated pages.

props.name: page
props.description: 应用确认的当前正整数页码，零结果可省略。
props.descriptionEn: A confirmed positive page index; omit for zero results.

props.name: totalPages
props.description: 必填非负整数总页数或 null=未知；在内容中明确未知状态。
props.descriptionEn: Required nonnegative total or null for unknown; explain unknown state visibly.

props.name: aria-label / render / ref / native props
props.description: 默认名称来自 locale。
props.descriptionEn: The default name is localized.

api.name: PaginationList / PaginationItem
api.description: ul / li 组织页面入口。
api.descriptionEn: ul / li organize page actions.

props.name: render / ref / native props
props.description: 保留原生列表结构。
props.descriptionEn: Preserve native list structure.

api.name: PaginationLink
api.description: a，匹配当前页时 aria-current=page。
api.descriptionEn: An anchor with aria-current=page for the current page.

props.name: page / href / render / ref / native props
props.description: 应用提供正整数页码与真实目标。
props.descriptionEn: The application supplies positive page indices and real destinations.

api.name: PaginationPrevious / PaginationNext
api.description: 复用 Button 与本地化方向名称。
api.descriptionEn: Button compositions with localized direction labels.

props.name: disabled / onClick / render / nativeButton / Button props
props.description: 应用明确禁用；导航可 render 为 a 并设 nativeButton=false。
props.descriptionEn: The caller supplies disabled facts; render an anchor with nativeButton=false for navigation.

api.name: PaginationEllipsis
api.description: 省略页名称，不代表末页。
api.descriptionEn: An omitted-pages marker, not a final page.

props.name: children / render / native props
props.description: 仅在已知有省略页时提供。
props.descriptionEn: Use only when omitted pages are known to exist.

notes: 不请求数据、保存路由或自动截取页码；未知总数不证明有无下一页。
notesEn: No fetching, routing or automatic page window; unknown totals establish no next-page availability.

metadata.title: 密码输入 PasswordInput
metadata.description: 输入密码，并可切换为明文核对。
metadata.descriptionEn: Enter a password and switch to plain text to check it.
metadata.decisions: 密码输入是组合，不是 Input 的一个模式：编辑边界（InputGroup）里放输入与一个显示密码的开关，都是公开部件。输入框只承载值；开关是附在边界上的另一个动作，名称固定为「显示密码」，按下与否由 aria-pressed 表达。开关不改内容、不提交表单；强度、规则与校验由应用给出。
metadata.decisionsEn: PasswordInput is a composition, not a mode of Input: the input and a show-password toggle sit inside one editing boundary (InputGroup), both public parts. The input only holds the value; the toggle is a separate action on the boundary with the stable name “Show password”, its state expressed by aria-pressed. The toggle changes no content and submits no form; strength, rules and validation come from the application.

whenToUse: 登录、设置或修改密码。
avoid: 一次性验证码用 OtpField。
用 placeholder 写密码规则：规则写在 FieldDescription。
composition: 与 FieldLabel、FieldDescription、FieldError 共处；autoComplete 写 current-password 或 new-password。

library: 共同边界、开关的名称与按下状态、受控或非受控的可见性。
application: 密码值、规则说明、校验事实与提交结果。

responsive: 宽度由所在容器决定；几何与 Input 相同，跟随密度轴。

metadata.title: 长文 Prose
metadata.description: 给已渲染的 Markdown / 富文本排版：一张独立的阅读纸，标题、列表、引用、代码、表格读已有的文字档与墨阶。
metadata.descriptionEn: Typesets already-rendered Markdown or rich text as an independent reading paper; headings, lists, quotes, code and tables read existing text tiers and ink roles.
metadata.decisions: Prose 不解析 Markdown、不内置渲染器：调用方用任意工具（react-markdown、MDX、服务端 HTML）产出原生元素，Prose 只用后代选择器给 h1–h4、p、strong/em、a、ul/ol（含任务列表）、blockquote、行内代码、pre > code、table、hr、img/figure/figcaption、kbd、details/summary 排版，不改写它们的结构或属性。
metadata.decisionsEn: Prose neither parses Markdown nor bundles a renderer: callers use any tool (react-markdown, MDX, server-rendered HTML) to produce native elements, and Prose only typesets h1–h4, p, strong/em, a, ul/ol (including task lists), blockquote, inline code, pre > code, table, hr, img/figure/figcaption, kbd and details/summary through descendant selectors, without rewriting their structure or attributes.

whenToUse: 展示一段已经渲染好的长文或 Markdown 结果：帮助文章、更新日志、AI 回复、文档正文。
avoid: Prose 不解析 Markdown 字符串；把原始文本交给具体渲染器，渲染结果再放进 Prose。
短小的字段说明或摘要用 Text；Prose 是给整段长文排版，不是通用的富文本容器。
composition: children 是渲染器产出的原生元素树，或经审查的 dangerouslySetInnerHTML；Prose 只加一层 className。
表格读与 Table 组件相同的视觉规则（清染表头/表尾、行高、数字列等宽），行内代码读 Typography 的 Code 规则，链接读 Link 的 linkClassName，不另起一套画法。

library: 标题、段落、列表、引用、代码、表格、分隔线、图片、键位、详情框的排版与墨阶。
application: Markdown 解析、内容本身、任务列表勾选框的完成事实、脚注与链接目标。

responsive: 版心固定 38em，不随视口拉宽；内缘在窄屏收紧到既有面板内缘的窄屏取值。
很宽的表格目前不会在 Prose 内独立横向滚动（纸的圆角需要 overflow-hidden 而非 overflow-x-auto），只能按单元格自然换行——已知缺口，非默认画法缺失。
customization: 使用公开 render/ref/className/style 与原生属性；不混用主题三轴。

whenToUse: Present an already-rendered long-form or Markdown result: a help article, a changelog entry, an AI reply, or documentation body copy.
avoid: Prose does not parse Markdown strings; hand raw text to an actual renderer first and place its output inside Prose.
Use Text for short field descriptions or summaries; Prose typesets a whole long-form passage, not a general rich-text container.
composition: Children are the renderer's native element tree, or reviewed dangerouslySetInnerHTML; Prose only adds one className.

Tables read the same visual rules as the Table component (washed header/footer bands, row height, tabular numeric cells); inline code reads Typography's Code rule; links read Link's linkClassName — none of these get a second drawing.

library: Typesetting and ink roles for headings, paragraphs, lists, quotes, code, tables, rules, images, keys and disclosure widgets.
application: Markdown parsing, the content itself, task-list completion facts, footnotes and link destinations.

responsive: The measure is a fixed 38em and does not widen with the viewport; the inset tightens to the existing panel padding's narrow value.

A very wide table does not yet scroll independently inside Prose (the paper's rounded corners need overflow-hidden rather than overflow-x-auto), so cells simply wrap — a known gap, not a missing default treatment.

metadata.title: 两量关系 ScatterChart
metadata.description: 两个数值量之间的关系；全比较形式，1 至 3 个系列，同源的散点图、命名的双轴与按需展开的数据表。
metadata.descriptionEn: The relationship between two numeric quantities; an all-pairs form with one to three series, a same-source scatter plot, named axes and an on-demand data table.
metadata.decisions: x、y 都是数值轴——这是散点的任务定义，不是违反「永远一个数值轴」；该禁令禁止的是同一类别轴上叠两条不同量纲的 Y 轴制造虚假相关。全比较形式最多 3 个系列，超过应合并为「其他」或拆成多图。
metadata.decisionsEn: Both x and y are value axes by the task's own definition, not a violation of "always one value axis" — that ban targets stacking two different-unit Y-axes on one shared category axis, which fabricates correlation. As an all-pairs form it accepts at most three series; more should fold into "Other" or split into separate charts.

api.name: ScatterChart
api.description: figure 名称、命名的双轴、按系列着色的标记与同源可见 Table。
api.descriptionEn: A named figure, named x/y axes, series-colored markers and a visible same-source Table.

props.name: label
props.description: 非空真实语义名称。
props.descriptionEn: A nonempty semantic name for the actual data.

props.name: xLabel / yLabel
props.description: 横轴与纵轴量的是什么，例如「记录数」「失败率」。
props.descriptionEn: What the x and y axes measure, e.g. "records" and "failure rate".

props.name: series
props.type: readonly { key: string; label: string; points: readonly { id: string; label: string; x: number; y: number }[] }[]
props.description: 1 至 3 个系列。只有一个系列时取第一色、不显示图例；两个以上按 chart1..3 取色并配不同标记形状。每个点需要稳定 id 与非空名称。
props.descriptionEn: One to three series. A single series takes the first color without a legend; two or more take the chart1..3 order with distinct marker shapes. Every point needs a stable id and a nonempty name.

props.name: formatX / formatY
props.description: 格式化已知数值；默认按 UILocale 数值 Intl。
props.descriptionEn: Format known values; defaults to Intl number formatting for UILocale.

notes: 超过 3 个系列会抛出错误：全比较形式任意两点都可能相邻，色觉校验比相邻校验更严，更多系列应合并为「其他」或改用小图版面拆分。
点的命中区≥24px，大于 8px 的可见标记，指针不必正中标记。
x、y 轴域按实际数据范围加少量留白，不强制从零起——散点不是从基线生长的柱。
悬停读数只增强，不替代按需展开的等价数据表。
notesEn: More than three series throws: as an all-pairs form any two points may sit adjacent, so its color-vision check is stricter than an adjacent check; fold extra series into "Other" or split into small multiples.
Each point's hit area is at least 24px, larger than its visible 8px marker; the pointer need not land dead-center.
The x and y domains pad slightly around the actual data range rather than forcing a zero baseline — a scatter point does not grow from a baseline like a bar.
Hover readouts only enhance; they never replace the on-demand equivalent data table.

whenToUse: 需要看两个数值量之间是否存在关系，例如记录数与失败率。
avoid: 只有一个数值要展示（用 Stat）；随时间的单一趋势（用 Chart line/area）；类别之间的比较（用 Chart bar）。
composition: Recharts 公开原语 + 当前 Table；复用 Chart 的 Marker 标记与悬停外壳。没有可画的点时，调用方在原位改放 Empty。

library: 同源投影、可见等价表、标记形态与基础名称。
application: 数据、量纲、真实性与状态文字。

responsive: 图高集中预设可覆写，表格原生滚动/换行。
customization: chart1..3 语义色；不另造散点调色板。

whenToUse: Checking whether two numeric quantities are related, e.g. record count and failure rate.
avoid: A single number to show (use Stat); a single trend over time (use Chart line/area); comparison between categories (use Chart bar).
composition: Public Recharts primitives with the current Table; reuses Chart's Marker shapes and hover shell. With no point to plot, the caller renders Empty in place of the chart.

library: Same-source projection, visible equivalent table, marker shapes and basic naming.
application: Data, units, truth and state content.

responsive: The centralized plot-height preset can be overridden; the table scrolls and wraps natively.
customization: chart1..3 semantic colors; no separate scatter palette.

metadata.title: 搜索输入 SearchInput
metadata.description: 输入一个搜索词，并能一步清空。
metadata.descriptionEn: Enter a search term and clear it in one step.
metadata.decisions: 搜索输入是组合，不是 Input 的一个模式：编辑边界（InputGroup）里依次放搜索图标、输入、清空动作，三者都是公开部件。输入框只承载值；清空是附在边界上的另一个动作，有自己的名称与焦点。它只持有搜索词，不发请求、不决定何时搜索，也不显示结果。
metadata.decisionsEn: SearchInput is a composition, not a mode of Input: a search icon, the input, and a clear action sit inside one editing boundary (InputGroup), all public parts. The input only holds the value; clearing is a separate action on the boundary with its own name and focus. It holds the search term only: it sends no request, does not decide when to search, and shows no results.

whenToUse: 输入搜索词或就地筛选一个列表。
avoid: 普通文本字段用 Input；需要候选项时用 Autocomplete 或 Combobox。
只靠 placeholder 命名：提供 FieldLabel 或 aria-label。
composition: 与 FieldLabel 共处，或在工具条里以 aria-label 命名。需要别的附属动作时，用 InputGroup + InputGroupInput + InputGroupButton 自行组合。

library: 共同边界、搜索图标、清空动作的出现与焦点返回、首个 Escape 清空本字段。
application: 搜索词的含义、何时查询、结果、无结果与失败的表达。

responsive: 宽度由所在容器决定；几何与 Input 相同，跟随密度轴。
customization: className、style、render 与 ref 属于真实 input；controlClassName 属于编辑边界；clearLabel 改写清空动作的名称。

whenToUse: Entering a search term or filtering a list in place.
avoid: Use Input for an ordinary text field; use Autocomplete or Combobox when candidates are offered.
Naming it by placeholder alone: provide FieldLabel or aria-label.
composition: Pair with FieldLabel, or name it with aria-label in a toolbar. For other adjunct actions, compose InputGroup + InputGroupInput + InputGroupButton yourself.

library: The shared boundary, the search icon, when the clear action appears and where focus returns, and the first Escape clearing this field.
application: What the term means, when to query, and how results, no results and failure are expressed.

responsive: Width follows the container; geometry matches Input and follows the density axis.
customization: className, style, render and ref belong to the real input; controlClassName belongs to the editing boundary; clearLabel renames the clear action.

api.name: SearchInput
api.description: InputGroup + 搜索图标 + Input（type=search）+ 清空动作。
api.descriptionEn: InputGroup + search icon + Input (type=search) + a clear action.

props.name: value / defaultValue / onChange / onValueChange
props.description: 受控与非受控值；清空沿同一条原生事件链更新值。
props.descriptionEn: Controlled and uncontrolled values; clearing updates the value through the same native event path.

props.name: onClear
props.description: 清空之后调用；值的变化已由 onChange / onValueChange 送出。清空不提交表单。
props.descriptionEn: Called after clearing; the value change has already been sent through onChange / onValueChange. Clearing does not submit a form.

props.name: clearLabel
props.description: 清空动作的名称，默认从 locale 读取。
props.descriptionEn: Name of the clear action, read from the locale by default.

props.name: readOnly / disabled
props.description: 只读与禁用时不出现清空动作；禁用同样服从 Field 与原生 fieldset。
props.descriptionEn: No clear action when read only or disabled; disabling also follows Field and a native fieldset.

props.name: className / style / render / ref
props.description: 全部作用于真实 input。
props.descriptionEn: Applied to the real input.

props.name: controlClassName
props.description: 作用于编辑边界，例如宽度。
props.descriptionEn: Applied to the editing boundary, e.g. its width.

props.name: 其余 InputProps（除 type / unstyled）
props.description: placeholder、name、form、aria-* 等原样透传给输入。
props.descriptionEn: placeholder, name, form, aria-* and the rest are forwarded to the input.

keyboard.description: 在输入与清空动作之间移动。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Move between the input and the clear action.

keyboard.description: 非空且可编辑时清空本字段，之后的 Escape 交给外层；输入法组字与调用方取消时保留草稿。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Clear this field when it is nonempty and editable; a later Escape reaches the parent. Composition and caller cancellation preserve the draft.

keyboard.description: 焦点在清空动作上时清空并把焦点还给输入，不提交表单。
keyboard.descriptionEn: On the clear action: clear, return focus to the input, and do not submit the form.

notes: 此前写作 Input type="search" 的用法改为 SearchInput；Input 的 clearable / clearLabel / onClear 已移除。普通字段需要清空时用 InputGroup + InputGroupButton 组合。
notesEn: Replace Input type="search" with SearchInput; Input's clearable / clearLabel / onClear are removed. For a clear action on an ordinary field, compose InputGroup + InputGroupButton.

props.description: 值、类型搜索名称、禁用事实。禁用项可高亮供辨认，但不能选取。

props.name: children / render / ref / className / style
props.description: 名称内容自动进入 ItemText，选中勾标单独呈现。

api.name: SelectGroup / SelectGroupLabel
api.description: 语义分组与组名称。
api.descriptionEn: Semantic grouping and group names.

api.description: 完整 Base UI Select 原语出口；公共 Select 接口始终为单值。
api.descriptionEn: The complete public Base UI Select primitive; public Select remains single-value.

keyboard.description: 进入触发器。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Reach the trigger.

keyboard.description: 打开候选；展开后方向键移动高亮，Enter/Space 选择。

keyboard.description: 展开时移动到首/尾候选。

keyboard.description: 类型搜索；展开时高亮匹配项，关闭时原语可直接选择匹配值。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Typeahead highlights matches while open; the closed primitive may select a matching value directly.

keyboard.description: 关闭并回到触发器，保留原值。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Close and return to the trigger, retaining the original value.

notes: FieldLabel 命名触发器，FieldError 关联错误；SelectGroupLabel 命名候选分组。
null 是未选择，空字符串和 0 可作为候选；原生表单可能把 null 与空字符串都序列化为空。
只读保留当前值，禁用项不能选取。
自身 Positioner 消费共享 popup 层级，父工作面内候选高于该工作面；positionerProps 保留调用方 style/ref/render。
notesEn: FieldLabel names the trigger, FieldError associates errors, and SelectGroupLabel names candidate groups.
null is no selection; empty string and zero can be candidates. Native forms may serialize null and empty string identically as empty.
Read-only retains the current value; disabled candidates cannot be selected.
Its Positioner consumes shared popup layers; candidates inside a parent workspace sit above it. positionerProps retain caller styles/refs/render.
metadata.decisions: 高亮表示当前位置，选取才改变值。未选择不会自动变为第一项；需要并置比较时用 RadioGroup。
metadata.decisionsEn: Highlight marks position; selection changes the value. No selection does not choose the first item automatically. Use RadioGroup for side-by-side comparison.

whenToUse: 已知单值候选，平时只需辨认当前选择
avoid: 需要并置比较的少量候选用 RadioGroup
大量候选需过滤时用 Combobox
命令用 Menu，视角用 Tabs
关键原生选择行为用 NativeSelect
composition: FieldLabel + Select + FieldDescription + FieldError；SelectGroup 提供候选分组

customization: 同档文字和控件尺寸、bordered padding、角色颜色、Portal container

whenToUse: Known single-value candidates whose current choice usually suffices.
avoid: Use RadioGroup for small sets needing side-by-side comparison.
Use Combobox when many candidates need filtering.
Use Menu for commands and Tabs for views.
Use NativeSelect for essential native picker behavior.
composition: FieldLabel + Select + FieldDescription + FieldError; SelectGroup groups candidates.

library: Focus, opening, highlight, and uncontrolled values.
application: Controlled values, candidates, invalid facts, loading/failure/unknown states, and save facts.

responsive: Retains -narrow and coarse-pointer roles; this batch checked desktop only.

metadata.title: 分隔线 Separator
metadata.description: 在已有内容组之间表达分界，可选择语义分隔或装饰线。
metadata.descriptionEn: Express a boundary between content groups as a semantic separator or decorative line.
metadata.decisions: 标题与间距足够表达关系时不加线。Separator 没有拖动、按钮或面板调整行为。
metadata.decisionsEn: Omit a line when headings and spacing already express the relation. Separator has no drag, button, or panel-resizing behavior.

whenToUse: 两组内容确需可辨认分界。
avoid: 每两行画线；把静态分界当拖动入口。
composition: 标题说明内容范围；有文字的 FieldSeparator 使用装饰线避免重复语义。

library: Base UI 分隔原语、方向、装饰选择。
application: 分界位置与辅助技术是否需要感知。

responsive: 长轴跟随容器；竖线依实际行布局拉伸。
customization: 强边界颜色与 1px 线条为表达预设；className 最后合并，render 与原生属性透传。

whenToUse: Two content groups need a discernible boundary.
avoid: Lines between every pair of rows or static boundaries impersonating drag entries.
composition: Headings explain scope; text FieldSeparator uses decorative lines to avoid repeated semantics.

library: Base UI separator primitive, orientation, and decorative choice.
application: Boundary placement and whether assistive technology needs it.

responsive: The long axis follows its container; vertical lines stretch with actual row layout.
customization: Strong boundary color and 1px lines are presets. External classes merge last; render/native props forward.

api.name: Separator
api.description: 基于 Base UI Separator；默认 role=separator。
api.descriptionEn: Based on Base UI Separator; role=separator by default.

props.name: orientation
props.description: 横向跨容器；纵向在 flex 行里拉伸。
props.descriptionEn: Horizontal spans the container; vertical stretches in a flex row.

props.name: decorative
props.description: true 时 role=presentation 且 aria-hidden=true。
props.descriptionEn: When true, uses role=presentation and aria-hidden=true.

props.name: className / style / render / ref
props.description: 作用于分界本身；样式支持方向状态函数。
props.descriptionEn: Applied to the separator; styles support orientation state functions.

api.name: SeparatorPrimitive
api.description: Base UI 原语出口。
api.descriptionEn: Base UI primitive outlet.

keyboard.description: 静态分隔不进入键盘焦点顺序。
keyboard.descriptionEn: A static separator does not enter the tab order.

notes: 装饰线不承担辅助技术语义。需要拖动改变尺寸时使用具有调整行为的控件。
必要非文本边界与真实承载面的对比至少 3:1；图片与未知承载面另行验证。
notesEn: Decorative lines carry no assistive-technology semantics. Use a control with resize behavior when dragging must change dimensions.
Necessary non-text boundaries need at least 3:1 contrast against the real carrier. Images and unknown carriers need separate checks.

metadata.title: 侧栏导航 Sidebar
metadata.description: 长期导航、收起为图标 rail 与二级子级。
metadata.descriptionEn: Persistent navigation, an icon rail when collapsed, and an expandable sub-level.
metadata.decisions: 收起是图标 rail，不是隐藏：导航与链接保持挂载，名称切到视觉隐藏（可访问名称不变），用 Tooltip 补足可见名称；二级子级展开态用内嵌面板，rail 态换成同一组内容的 Popover，开合记忆不因侧栏收起而改变。active 与路由由应用明确提供。
metadata.decisionsEn: Collapsing produces an icon rail, not a hidden panel: navigation and links stay mounted, names switch to visually hidden (accessible name unchanged) with a Tooltip restoring a visible name; a sub-level's inline panel becomes a Popover over the same content in the rail, and its open/closed memory survives collapsing. Active and routes are explicit application facts.

api.name: Sidebar / SidebarToggle
api.description: aside 与可逆开关。
api.descriptionEn: An aside and reversible toggle.

props.name: collapsed / defaultCollapsed / onCollapsedChange
props.description: 默认展开；details.cancel() 拒绝变化。
props.descriptionEn: Expanded by default; details.cancel() rejects a change.

props.name: render / ref / native props
props.description: 属性和 ref 归属实际元素；调用方事件与样式保留。
props.descriptionEn: Props and refs target actual elements; caller events and styles are preserved.

api.name: SidebarContent / SidebarGroup / SidebarGroupLabel
api.description: 原生 nav 与导航组。
api.descriptionEn: A native nav and navigation groups.

props.name: render / ref / native props
props.description: 属性和 ref 归属实际元素；调用方事件与样式保留。
props.descriptionEn: Props and refs target actual elements; caller events and styles are preserved.

api.name: SidebarLink
api.description: 真实页面链接。
api.descriptionEn: A real page link.

props.name: href / active
props.description: active 显式写 aria-current；焦点所在之处收起后真的不可达时，才会回退到 Toggle（例如焦点原本在一个二级子级里，侧栏收起换成 rail）。
props.descriptionEn: Active explicitly writes aria-current; focus only falls back to Toggle when its location truly becomes unreachable after collapsing (for example, focus was inside a sub-level that the rail replaces).

props.name: icon
props.description: 收起为 rail 时唯一可见的识别物；没有图标的条目收起后没有可展示的内容。名称（children）在 rail 下只是视觉隐藏（sr-only），可访问名称不变，并由 Tooltip 把名称重新摆给看得见的人。
props.descriptionEn: The only visible identifier in the rail; a link without an icon has nothing to show once collapsed. The name (children) is only visually hidden (sr-only) in the rail — the accessible name is unchanged, and a Tooltip restores a sighted label.

props.name: render / ref / native props
props.description: 属性和 ref 归属实际元素；调用方事件与样式保留。
props.descriptionEn: Props and refs target actual elements; caller events and styles are preserved.

api.name: SidebarSub / SidebarSubTrigger / SidebarSubContent
api.description: 可展开的二级目的地：展开态是内嵌面板，rail 态换成同一组链接的 Popover，悬停或聚焦都能打开。
api.descriptionEn: An expandable sub-level of destinations: an inline panel when expanded, and a Popover over the same links in the rail, reachable by hover or focus.

props.name: SidebarSub：open / defaultOpen / onOpenChange
props.description: 展开态与 rail 态共用同一个开合状态；rail 下即使换成 Popover，用户的开合记忆也不因收起/展开侧栏而改变。
props.descriptionEn: The same open state serves both the expanded panel and the rail's Popover; the remembered open/closed state survives collapsing even though the rail swaps in a Popover.

props.name: SidebarSubTrigger：icon
props.description: 与 SidebarLink 的 icon 同一分工；rail 下按钮不再承担内嵌展开，只作为 Popover 入口，避免收起侧栏悄悄改变用户没点开过的展开记忆。
props.descriptionEn: Same split as SidebarLink's icon; in the rail the button no longer toggles the inline panel, only opening the Popover, so collapsing never silently changes an open state the user never chose.

notes: 应用决定展开宽度；收起宽度由库按一个填值控件高加两侧内缩给出，始终保留可见 Toggle。
当前项有两个线索：面，加一段焦墨线。一级条目的线在条目起始边内侧，二级条目加深的是引导线上自己那一段；线宽与字重都不变。
当前项的面随承载面：默认侧栏比纸深一级，当前项是纸色。项目把 --qy-sidebar 调到纸色或接近纸色时，把 --qy-sidebar-current 设为 var(--qy-surface-active)，当前项改为淡染。
notesEn: Applications choose the expanded width; the collapsed rail's width is given by the library as one fill control height plus insets on both sides, and a visible Toggle is always available.

The current item carries two cues: its surface and a segment of ink line. A top-level item draws the line inside its starting edge; a sub-level item deepens its own segment of the guide line. Neither line width nor font weight changes.

The current item's surface follows its host: by default the sidebar is one step darker than paper and the current item is paper. When a project moves --qy-sidebar to or near paper, set --qy-sidebar-current to var(--qy-surface-active) so the current item becomes a wash.

whenToUse: 工作面旁的长期导航。
avoid: 窄屏弹层抽屉用 Drawer；不内置业务目录。

library: 收起、nav 语义与焦点返回。
application: 真实目的地、active 和布局宽度。

responsive: 桌面保持真实结构；菜单受可用空间限制，表格保留完整比较列。
customization: 控件档案、间距和浮层表面消费现有角色；具体外观是预设。

whenToUse: Persistent navigation beside a workspace.
avoid: Use Drawer for a narrow-screen overlay; no built-in business directory.

library: Collapsing, nav semantics, and focus return.
application: Actual destinations, active state, and layout width.

responsive: Keep actual desktop structure; menus fit available space and tables retain complete comparison columns.
customization: Control profiles, spacing, and popup surfaces consume existing roles; their appearance is a preset.

metadata.title: 骨架屏 Skeleton
metadata.description: 内容到达之前，先摆出它将占的位置与行数。
metadata.descriptionEn: Hold the place and row count content will take until it arrives.
metadata.decisions: 骨架只表达「正在加载」，不表达进度，也不替应用决定何时结束，更不自行超时；到达、失败或为空时换成真内容或 Empty，不让占位一直留着。正文行高是一材，一行骨架占一材、行间不留缝，所以 N 行骨架恰是 N 行正文，内容到达版面不动。填充是清染（大面）与清墨（小条）的透明墨，不脉动：等待没有「变化」可说，循环明灭只是装饰。
metadata.decisionsEn: A skeleton says only that content is loading; it carries no progress, does not decide when loading ends, and never times out by itself. On arrival, failure or an empty result it is replaced by the real content or Empty, never left in place. Body leading is one module, so a skeleton row takes one module with no gap between rows: N rows are exactly N lines of text and the page does not move on arrival. Fills are transparent ink (a faint wash for large areas, a faint ink for small bars) and do not pulse: waiting has no change to report, and a looping fade is decoration.

whenToUse: 首次加载的内容区域，形状已知、几行几块可预期。
avoid: 刷新时保留仍然有效的工作面，不退回骨架；等待由发起它的 Button（loading）与一条 Progress 表达，二者共用一个等待周期。
加载失败或结果为空时改用 Empty，不让占位冒充内容。
不确定形状或时间极短的等待，用按钮的 loading。
composition: Skeleton 包住一组 SkeletonLine / SkeletonBlock，摆成真实内容的版式；到达后整体换掉，版面不跳。

library: 一句名称（跟随语言）、形状对辅助技术隐藏、以材为度的行高与墨色。
application: 何时开始与结束、久等的处置、内容的真实形状、失败与为空的处置。

responsive: 宽度由所在容器决定，行宽用 className 表达；行高固定为一材。
customization: className 调整行宽与块高；label 写明对象，如「正在加载成员」。

whenToUse: The first load of a region whose shape is known: how many rows and blocks to expect.
avoid: Refreshing keeps the content that is still valid and does not fall back to a skeleton; the wait is shown on the Button that started it (loading) and on a Progress band, both of which share one wait period.
A failed or empty result uses Empty; a placeholder never stands in for content.
A wait of unknown shape or very short duration uses a Button's loading.
composition: Skeleton wraps SkeletonLine / SkeletonBlock laid out like the real content; on arrival the whole is replaced and the page does not jump.

library: One localized name, shapes hidden from assistive technology, row height and ink derived from the module.
application: When loading starts and ends, how a long wait is handled, the real shape of the content, and how failure and emptiness are handled.

responsive: Width follows the container; express row width with className. Row height is one module.
customization: className adjusts row width and block height; label names the object, e.g. “Loading members”.

api.name: Skeleton
api.description: 外层 status，内含一句名称；形状放在其中。
api.descriptionEn: The outer status, holding one name; shapes sit inside.

props.name: label
props.description: 替代默认的「正在加载」，写明对象。
props.descriptionEn: Replaces the default “Loading”, naming the object.

props.name: render / ref / 原生属性
props.description: 属性、事件与 ref 透传实际元素；样式由 className/style 调整。
props.descriptionEn: Forward attributes, events and refs to the actual element; adjust presentation through className/style.

api.name: SkeletonLine
api.description: 一行文字的位置，占一材；宽度由 className 给出。
api.descriptionEn: The place of one text line, one module high; width comes from className.

props.name: className
props.description: 行宽，例如 w-2/3。
props.descriptionEn: Row width, e.g. w-2/3.

api.name: SkeletonBlock
api.description: 整块内容（图、图表、表格）的位置；高度由 className 给出。
api.descriptionEn: The place of a whole block (image, chart, table); height comes from className.

props.name: className
props.description: 块高，例如 h-40。
props.descriptionEn: Block height, e.g. h-40.

metadata.title: 滑块 Slider
metadata.description: 在明确区间内输入数值或有序范围。
metadata.descriptionEn: Enter a number or an ordered range within explicit bounds.

api.name: Slider
api.description: 数值与范围状态，公开各部位供组合。
api.descriptionEn: Value and range state with public parts for composition.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: 受控值或非受控初值；未传时从 min 开始。数组每项对应一个带 index 的 Thumb。
props.descriptionEn: Controlled or uncontrolled initial value; omission starts at min. Each array entry corresponds to an indexed Thumb.

props.name: min / max / step / largeStep
props.description: 有限 min<max，正步进；min 是步进原点，max 必须落在步进上。越界、非有限或未对齐的显式值抛 RangeError，不静默纠正。
props.descriptionEn: Finite min<max and positive steps; min is the origin and max must align. Explicit out-of-range, nonfinite, or misaligned values throw RangeError without silent correction.

props.name: minStepsBetweenValues / thumbCollisionBehavior
props.description: 有序范围的最小间距和指针碰撞策略；显式数组必须满足间距。
props.descriptionEn: Minimum separation and pointer collision strategy for an ordered range; explicit arrays must satisfy spacing.

props.name: onValueChange / onValueCommitted
props.description: 即时值与本次操作提交；details.reason 对应 keyboard/drag/track-press/input-change，可取消变化。提交不等于持久化成功。
props.descriptionEn: Immediate changes and the current interaction's commit. details.reason identifies keyboard/drag/track-press/input-change; changes are cancelable. Commit does not establish successful persistence.

props.name: disabled / readOnly
props.description: 禁用不提交表单；只读保留名称、焦点、值和提交，取消所有原语变化。
props.descriptionEn: Disabled excludes form submission. Read-only retains names, focus, values, and submission while canceling primitive changes.

props.name: name / form
props.description: 表单名与外部 form；多个 Thumb 以同名字段重复序列化。
props.descriptionEn: Form name and external form; multiple Thumbs serialize repeated fields under the same name.

props.name: orientation / thumbAlignment
props.description: 工作高度跟随填值控件的一套几何；抓手跟随标签文字，密度不改它。edge 让端点位于工作范围内。
props.descriptionEn: The working height follows the one fill-control geometry; the thumb follows its label text and is untouched by density. edge keeps endpoints within the workspace.

props.name: format / locale / render / ref / className / style
props.description: 数值格式、语言、根部位和原语状态样式；主题轴独立。
props.descriptionEn: Number formatting, locale, root composition, and primitive state styles; theme axes remain independent.

api.name: SliderControl / SliderTrack / SliderIndicator
api.description: 交互工作区、完整范围与实际输入区间。
api.descriptionEn: Interactive workspace, complete range, and actual input interval.

props.name: render / ref / className / style
props.description: 各部位透传 ARIA、data 与原生事件；轨道厚度读 slider-track-size，纵向工作长度读 slider-vertical-length。
props.descriptionEn: Parts forward ARIA, data, and native events. Track thickness reads slider-track-size and vertical extent reads slider-vertical-length.

api.name: SliderThumb
api.description: 可拖动部位，包含真实 range input。
api.descriptionEn: Draggable part containing an actual range input.

props.name: index / aria-label / getAriaLabel
props.description: 区间每个 Thumb 指定 index，并给出能区分上下限的名称。
props.descriptionEn: Specify each range Thumb's index and a name distinguishing its lower/upper meaning.

props.name: getAriaValueText / aria-valuetext / inputRef
props.description: 默认读屏值是格式化数值，不添加英语上下限文案。可传单位与读屏值；inputRef、onKeyDown/onFocus/onBlur 对应真实 input。
props.descriptionEn: The default accessible value is a formatted number without added English bound labels. Supply units/value text as needed; inputRef and onKeyDown/onFocus/onBlur target the actual input.

props.name: disabled / render / ref / className / style
props.description: 单项禁用与公开部位组合；readOnly 和 Field invalid 接到真实 input 的 ARIA。
props.descriptionEn: Per-item disabling and public composition; readOnly and Field invalid reach actual input ARIA.

api.name: SliderLabel / SliderValue
api.description: 关联所有 Thumb 的名称与实际数值 output。Value 的 children 接收 formattedValues/values。
api.descriptionEn: Names associated with all Thumbs and actual numeric output. Value children receives formattedValues/values.

api.name: SliderPrimitive
api.description: Base UI Slider 原语命名空间。
api.descriptionEn: Base UI Slider primitive namespace.

keyboard.description: 依次到达可用滑块。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Reach available thumbs in sequence.

keyboard.description: 按 step 改值；方向与 orientation/RTL 一致。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Change by step, respecting orientation/RTL.

keyboard.description: 到达允许的起止端点。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Reach permitted starting/ending bounds.

keyboard.description: 按 largeStep 改值，受区间与相邻值约束。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Change by largeStep within range and neighboring-value constraints.

notes: 必须给 SliderLabel 或每个 Thumb 的名称，多滑块名称需要区分。
原语交互按步进吸附；显式无效值会抛 RangeError。
4px 轨道厚度和 10rem 纵向长度是集中预设，修改 tokens/components.css 或项目主题；浏览器对比与几何仍需验收。
notesEn: Provide SliderLabel or a name for each Thumb; multiple-thumb names must differ.
Primitive interaction snaps to steps; explicit invalid values throw RangeError.
4px track thickness and 10rem vertical length are central presets, adjustable in tokens/components.css or project themes. Actual browser contrast/geometry still require acceptance.
metadata.decisions: Slider 输入真实数值。进度使用 Progress，测量结果使用 Meter；onValueCommitted 只表示当前交互提交。
metadata.decisionsEn: Slider inputs actual numeric values. Use Progress for progress and Meter for measurements; onValueCommitted indicates only the current interaction's commit.

whenToUse: 有明确有限范围与步进的数值
需要拖动调整的数值区间
avoid: 精确键入使用 NumberField
进度或未知任务状态不用 Slider
